title: Concept: npm client ignores peer-dependency conflicts
description: .npmrc declares a client setting that installs despite conflicting peer requirements, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The tree that installs is one npm itself refused to accept, so an incompatible transitive copy can shadow the version the project tested.
risk: The tree that installs is one npm itself refused to accept, so an incompatible transitive copy can shadow the version the project tested.
